title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and explore turns in both directions.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 uses in front and behind. Q2 uses above and below. Q3 identifies a 3-quarter turn from right. Q4 identifies a 3-quarter turn from down. Q5 identifies a 4-quarter turn from left. Q6 predicts a 3-quarter turn from up. Q7 predicts a 3-quarter turn from right. Q8 predicts a 3-quarter turn from down. Q9 predicts a 3-quarter turn from left. Q10 predicts a 4-quarter turn from right.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, then supported quarter-turn predictions. Medium identifies and predicts quarter and half turns in both directions. Hard adds three-quarter turns, varied starts and whole-turn distinctions. All use one shared arrow diagram and single-choice spatial fluency to avoid interaction changes.

questions.prompt: Pip stands behind a box. Where is the box?
questions.explanation: The box is in front of Pip because Pip stands behind it.

questions.prompt: A shelf is above a box. Where is the box?
questions.explanation: The box is below the shelf because the shelf is above it.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A three-quarter turn goes three of four equal parts of the way round.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A three-quarter turn goes three of four equal parts of the way round.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A whole turn goes all the way round and finishes in the starting direction.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing up, a three-quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing left.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a three-quarter turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing right, a three-quarter turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing down.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing down, a three-quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing right.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a three-quarter turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing left, a three-quarter turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing up.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a whole turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing right, a whole turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing right.
